title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：motive　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 motive 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the elder ① found the motive that no youth in the village would have recorded, and he said the finding was the whole of the year. The ② motive, meaning the reason itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a motive, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ motive in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ motive at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A motive, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the elder said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the motive was the whole of the matter, meaning the desire and not the reason. The ⑥ motive, meaning the desire and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; motive, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a reason and a desire. He said the desire is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ motive had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ motive of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of recording; motive, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ motive I remember is the reason recorded in the memoir, which closed in 1969 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ motive, my mother said in 1971, is the only reason that improves by being recorded; every motive, she said, is a desire that has agreed to look like a reason. She said the desire was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 动机；缘由（指村子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 动机；缘由（指那个动机本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the motive 找出这一个动机
D. n. 动机；缘由（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 动机之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的动机之事）
F. n. 动机；缘由（指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 动机、心愿（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心愿（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the motive that no youth in the village would have recorded
The motive, meaning the reason itself and not the staff
the motive at the far gate
the motive was the whole of the matter
the motive had become a line in a memoir
The motive of the whole thing
A motive, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: find the motive 意为“找出这一个动机”，1962 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记载的一个动机做了一遍。
motive 意为“动机；缘由”，指那个动机本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
motive 意为“动机；缘由”，指村子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
motive 意为“动机；缘由”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
motive 意为“动机、心愿”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个心愿就是那件事的全部。
motive 意为“心愿”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个动机，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
motive 意为“动机；缘由”，指回忆录里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1967 年这一个成了回忆录里的一行。
motive 意为“动机之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的动机之事是一处村子和三个年头的记载。
motive 意为“动机；缘由”，我记得的是回忆录里记载过的那一个，1969 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一个。
motive 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，动机是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的动机。
